say:2:1720403001:1.text: Magister, the West District is just up ahead...
say:2:1720403001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，前面就是西区了……
say:2:1720403001:1.male: Magister, the West District is just up ahead...
say:2:1720403001:1.female: Magister, the West District is just up ahead...

say:3:1720403002:1.text: If there's no reason for you to head that way, better turn back now.
say:3:1720403002:1.source_cn: 哎，你们要是没什么事的话，可千万别往前走了！

say:4:1720403003:1.source_cn: 前面是发生什么事了吗？

say:5:1720403004:1.text: There's a monkey running loose through the stalls, grabbing whatever food it can get its hands on! And it's got a talking parrot up on the rooftops calling out where to go next. They're working together!
say:5:1720403004:1.source_cn: 前面有猴子到处乱窜，抢摊位上的吃的！天上那只说人话的鹦...

say:6:1720403005:1.text: And the guards haven't done a thing. They've just been standing there watching it happen!
say:6:1720403005:1.source_cn: 那些守备军也是，就站那看着，一点用处都没有！

choice_prompt:7:1720403005.text: And the guards haven't done a thing. They've just been standing there watching it happen!
choice_prompt:7:1720403005.source_cn: 那些守备军也是，就站那看着，一点用处都没有！

say:8:1720403006:1.text: I know. I've never seen anything like it either!
say:8:1720403006:1.source_cn: 就是说啊！我活了这么久还是第一次见这种事！

say:10:1720403007:0.text: My sweets... it took my sweets... *Sobbing*
say:10:1720403007:0.source_cn: 我的糖果……被抢走了……呜呜……

say:11:1720403008:0.text: Look at that. The poor kid's still crying. Maybe it's best if we stay out of this.
say:11:1720403008:0.source_cn: 你看，孩子都被吓哭了。我们还是离远点吧。

say:0:1720404001:0.text: A monkey and a parrot teaming up to rob a festival? No, now I need to see this.
say:0:1720404001:0.source_cn: 猴子和鹦鹉组成的强盗团伙？这我倒要见识一下了。
say:0:1720404001:0.male: A monkey and a parrot teaming up to rob a festival? No, now I need to see this.
say:0:1720404001:0.female: A monkey and a parrot teaming up to rob a festival? No, now I need to see this.

say:2:1720406001:1.text: What am I paying you idiots for? It's one monkey and one parrot! I spent a fortune on those animals, and they were supposed to be a gift for the prince!
say:2:1720406001:1.source_cn: 一群废物！连只猴子跟鹦鹉都抓不住！那可是我从马戏团高价...

say:3:1720406002:1.text: My lord, the parrot keeps out of reach, and the monkey's too fast for us to corner...
say:3:1720406002:1.source_cn: 男爵大人，那只鹦鹉飞得太高了，那只猴子动作也很灵活……

say:4:1720406003:1.text: Save your excuses! I don't care how you do it. I want both of them back, and in one piece!
say:4:1720406003:1.source_cn: 别跟我废话那么多！听着！必须把它们毫发无伤地给我抓回来！

say:5:1720406004:1.text: Do that, and there's a fat reward waiting for you! Fail me, and you'll answer with your heads!
say:5:1720406004:1.source_cn: 抓到了，重重有赏！要是让它们跑了，你们就等着掉脑袋吧！

say:7:1720406005:1.text: The baron storms off, leaving the flustered guards, the robbed stall owners, and the curious townsfolk all looking at each other in disbelief.
say:7:1720406005:1.source_cn: 男爵气冲冲地离开了，留下束手无策的守备军、被抢的摊主和...

choice_prompt:8:1720406005.text: The baron storms off, leaving the flustered guards, the robbed stall owners, and the curious townsfolk all looking at each other in disbelief.
choice_prompt:8:1720406005.source_cn: 男爵气冲冲地离开了，留下束手无策的守备军、被抢的摊主和看热闹的市民们面面相觑。

say:10:1720406006:0.source_cn: 刚刚那人是谁啊？口气那么大！

say:12:1720406008:0.text: Never heard of him. Sounds like another rich fool who bought himself a title.
say:12:1720406008:0.source_cn: 听都没听说过，估计又是哪个从乡下来的暴发户吧。

say:13:1720406009:1.text: Savannah is crawling with nobles. You can't toss a pebble without hitting somebody with a title. What's he got to swagger about?
say:13:1720406009:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳的贵族遍地都是，天上掉下块石头，都能砸到不止一个...

say:14:1720406010:1.text: Hah. That sorry excuse for a baron looks more like a monkey than the monkey does. No amount of money would get me working for him!
say:14:1720406010:1.source_cn: 哼，那胖贵族自己就是个猴样！就算给我一万金币，我也不伺候他！

say:16:1720406011:0.text: A monkey and a parrot for the prince? That sounds fishy.
say:16:1720406011:0.source_cn: 他要献给王子猴子和鹦鹉？我看这事不简单。

say:17:1720406012:1.text: And what kind of gift are they, anyway? One bites, and the other never shuts up. For all we know, they may have been sent by the queen to harm His Highness.
say:17:1720406012:1.source_cn: 这猴子这么凶猛，鹦鹉这么聒噪，是不是王后那边派来的，想...

say:18:1720406013:1.text: Oh, don't start! The prince isn't about to be undone by one screeching bird and one apple-thieving pest.
say:18:1720406013:1.source_cn: 胡说！王子殿下英明神武，岂会怕这两个家伙？

say:19:1720406014:1.text: Maybe not. But he's not the queen's own son, is he? People are going to wonder...
say:19:1720406014:1.source_cn: 毕竟王子不是王后亲生的，不得不防啊……

say:20:1720406015:1.text: I heard the king's been very ill, and that royal stepmother's been walking around like the palace already belongs to her!
say:20:1720406015:1.source_cn: 我听说国王陛下病重，那位后妈现在可得意了！

say:21:1720406016:0.text: The prince has the people behind him. Petty tricks are all the queen has left!
say:21:1720406016:0.source_cn: 要我说，王子殿下是民心所向，王后也只能使点这些小伎俩了！

say:24:1720406017:0.text: Guard! Come on, do something! How am I supposed to keep selling with that little beast raiding every stall in sight?
say:24:1720406017:0.source_cn: 守备军小伙子，帮帮忙吧！这样下去我还怎么做生意啊！

say:25:1720406018:0.text: And how exactly do you expect me to catch it?

say:27:1720406019:0.text: You look up. The parrot is strutting along the rooftop, surveying the chaos below like a commander inspecting a battlefield. Nearby, the monkey has already polished off the stolen apple and lets out a loud, shameless belch.
say:27:1720406019:0.source_cn: 你抬头望去，只见那只鹦鹉正耀武扬威地在屋顶上踱步，像个...
say:27:1720406019:0.male: You look up. The parrot is strutting along the rooftop, surveying the chaos below like a commander inspecting a battlefield. Nearby, the monkey has already polished off the stolen apple and lets out a loud, shameless belch.
say:27:1720406019:0.female: You look up. The parrot is strutting along the rooftop, surveying the chaos below like a commander inspecting a battlefield. Nearby, the monkey has already polished off the stolen apple and lets out a loud, shameless belch.

say:28:1720406020:0.text: Then the parrot lets out a piercing shriek, almost like a signal. You react on instinct and yank Cassadee behind you.
say:28:1720406020:0.source_cn: 仿佛一声令下，鹦鹉发出一声刺耳的尖叫。你眼疾手快，一把...
say:28:1720406020:0.male: Then the parrot lets out a piercing shriek, almost like a signal. You react on instinct and yank Cassadee behind you.
say:28:1720406020:0.female: Then the parrot lets out a piercing shriek, almost like a signal. You react on instinct and yank Cassadee behind you.

say:29:1720406021:0.text: Just in time. An apple core comes whipping over your heads and slams into the ground, breaking into pieces.
say:29:1720406021:0.source_cn: 下一秒，猴子扔出的苹果核便呼啸着从你们头上飞过，砸在地...
say:29:1720406021:0.male: Just in time. An apple core comes whipping over your heads and slams into the ground, breaking into pieces.
say:29:1720406021:0.female: Just in time. An apple core comes whipping over your heads and slams into the ground, breaking into pieces.

say:32:1720406023:0.text: Squawk! Too slow! Too slow! Bye-bye! Bye-bye!

say:34:1720406024:0.text: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.
say:34:1720406024:0.source_cn: 这番赤裸裸的挑衅，彻底点燃了你的怒火——
say:34:1720406024:0.male: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.
say:34:1720406024:0.female: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.

choice_prompt:35:1720406024.text: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.
choice_prompt:35:1720406024.source_cn: 这番赤裸裸的挑衅，彻底点燃了你的怒火——
choice_prompt:35:1720406024.male: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.
choice_prompt:35:1720406024.female: That does it. Whatever patience you had left is gone.

say:37:1720406025:0.text: ... Oh no! They're making a run for it!

choice:35:0:1.text: Oh, we're not letting them get away with that!
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 我要狠狠收拾它们两个！
choice:35:0:1.male: Oh, we're not letting them get away with that!
choice:35:0:1.female: Oh, we're not letting them get away with that!

choice:35:1:2.text: It's time those little terrors learned their lesson!
choice:35:1:2.source_cn: 我得给它们点难忘的教训！
choice:35:1:2.male: It's time those little terrors learned their lesson!
choice:35:1:2.female: It's time those little terrors learned their lesson!

say:0:1720412001:0.text: Damn it! They went into the sewer!
say:0:1720412001:0.source_cn: 该死！它们逃进下水道了！

say:2:1720413001:1.text: Oh. It's you two. Funny, isn't it? Whole street full of people watching the show, and you're the only ones who actually came after them. Thanks.
say:2:1720413001:1.source_cn: 呼……是你们啊。刚才那么多在旁边看热闹的人，只有你们肯...

say:3:1720413002:1.text: And, ah... judging by your attire, miss, you must be a court mage. Sorry about this. I should've gotten those little devils under control before they started bothering the two of you.
say:3:1720413002:1.source_cn: 看这位小姐的衣着，您是宫廷魔法师吗？是我没用，让这两个...

say:4:1720413003:1.text: Can't believe I let them slip away right under my nose... That sewer's pitch-black, and too narrow for anyone to get through...
say:4:1720413003:1.source_cn: 可惜还是让它们逃掉了……这下水道又黑又窄，根本进不去……

say:5:1720413004:1.text: Ugh, just my luck. I knew I should've swapped shifts this morning! If I go back empty-handed, Lord Grandet's going to skin me alive!
say:5:1720413004:1.source_cn: 唉，太倒霉了，早知道今天就该跟人换班的！我就这么空手回...

choice_prompt:6:1720413004.text: Ugh, just my luck. I knew I should've swapped shifts this morning! If I go back empty-handed, Lord Grandet's going to skin me alive!
choice_prompt:6:1720413004.source_cn: 唉，太倒霉了，早知道今天就该跟人换班的！我就这么空手回去，那位葛朗台大人非得扒了我的皮不可！

say:7:1720413005:1.text: I'm helping too! But... how exactly are we getting in there?
say:7:1720413005:1.source_cn: 那我也来帮忙！可是我们要怎么进入下水道呢？

choice_prompt:8:1720413005.text: I'm helping too! But... how exactly are we getting in there?
choice_prompt:8:1720413005.source_cn: 那我也来帮忙！可是我们要怎么进入下水道呢？

say:10:1720413007:1.text: You can do transfiguration? That's incredible! Then... alright. I'll leave this to you.
say:10:1720413007:1.source_cn: 竟然有这么神奇的魔法？！太好了！那这件事就拜托两位了！

say:11:1720413008:1.text: I'll stay here and watch the entrance in case they try to sneak back out. Just be careful in there, alright?
say:11:1720413008:1.source_cn: 我就在入口这里守着，防止它们再从这里溜出来！请两位务必小心！

choice:8:0:1.text: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 人进不去，别的动物应该可以
choice:8:0:1.male: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.
choice:8:0:1.female: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我帮你抓住这两个家伙

choice:6:1:2.text: I'll make sure they regret it.
choice:6:1:2.male: I'll make sure they regret it.
choice:6:1:2.female: I'll make sure they regret it.

narration:0:1720427501:1.text: Some time later, you make your way back to the entrance...
narration:0:1720427501:1.male: Some time later, you make your way back to the entrance...
narration:0:1720427501:1.female: Some time later, you make your way back to the entrance...

say:2:1720428001:1.text: There you are! Please tell me you caught them...
say:2:1720428001:1.source_cn: 您终于出来了！那两个家伙……
say:2:1720428001:1.male: There you are! Please tell me you caught them...
say:2:1720428001:1.female: There you are! Please tell me you caught them...

say:3:1720428002:0.text: Took a bit more work than I'd have liked, but yes, we got them. Alright, you two, no more running around causing trouble!
say:3:1720428002:0.source_cn: 虽说费了一番功夫，最终还是抓到了。喂，小猴子，小鹦鹉，...

say:10:1720428005:1.text: Great. Baron Grandet is nearby. Let's get the monkey and parrot back to him and be done with this mess.
say:10:1720428005:1.source_cn: 太好了！那位葛朗台男爵就在附近，把猴子和鹦鹉还给他，也...

say:11:1720428006:0.text: They're slippery little nightmares, and I wouldn't put it past them to run off again. Would you mind taking them back yourselves, just to make sure they stay put?
say:11:1720428006:0.source_cn: 这两个家伙实在太调皮了，随时可能再次逃走。为保险起见，...

choice_prompt:12:1720428006.text: They're slippery little nightmares, and I wouldn't put it past them to run off again. Would you mind taking them back yourselves, just to make sure they stay put?
choice_prompt:12:1720428006.source_cn: 这两个家伙实在太调皮了，随时可能再次逃走。为保险起见，可以麻烦两位亲手交还给他吗？

say:13:1720428007:0.text: I'd rather not. You two caught them fair and square. It wouldn't feel right barging in now and taking the credit.
say:13:1720428007:0.source_cn: 我就不去了。毕竟是两位亲手抓到的，我可不能去抢这个功劳。

say:14:1720428008:0.text: And to be honest, that baron has a terrible temper. He's a lot nicer to mages than he is to the rest of us, and I'd rather not get yelled at again...
say:14:1720428008:0.source_cn: 而且，那位男爵大人脾气不好，但对魔法师还算客气，我实在...

say:2:1720429001:0.text: Who is it now?! Can't you see I'm busy?

say:3:1720429002:1.text: ... Oh. Miss, judging by your attire... are you perhaps...
say:3:1720429002:1.source_cn: ……哎，这位小姐，看您的着装，莫非您是……

say:4:1720429003:0.text: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.
say:4:1720429003:0.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，我是宫廷魔法师科丝蒂，和我在一起的这位是大...
say:4:1720429003:0.male: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.
say:4:1720429003:0.female: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.

say:5:1720429004:1.text: Oh dear! My eyes must be failing me. I hadn't realized I was in the presence of such distinguished company.
say:5:1720429004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，瞧我这眼睛，刚才背着光，竟没认出是两位魔法师大人...

choice_prompt:6:1720429004.text: Oh dear! My eyes must be failing me. I hadn't realized I was in the presence of such distinguished company.
choice_prompt:6:1720429004.source_cn: 哎呀，瞧我这眼睛，刚才背着光，竟没认出是两位魔法师大人大驾光临！

say:7:1720429005:1.text: My mistake, my mistake. Please forgive me.
say:7:1720429005:1.source_cn: 我的错我的错，实在是失敬，失敬！

say:8:1720429006:1.text: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!
say:8:1720429006:1.source_cn: 这位就是传说中的大魔法师梅林阁下？久仰大名，今日一见，...
say:8:1720429006:1.male: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!
say:8:1720429006:1.female: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!

say:9:1720429007:0.text: Baron, we caught the two little troublemakers from the plaza. Are they yours?
say:9:1720429007:0.source_cn: 男爵，我们抓到了这两只在广场上作乱的小家伙。它们是你遗...

say:13:1720429009:0.text: Squawk! Cage! Hate it! Hate it!

say:15:1720429010:1.text: Let me see... yes, that's them. Those two little monsters are mine!
say:15:1720429010:1.source_cn: ……我看看，没错，没错！就是这两个小祖宗！

say:16:1720429011:1.text: I'm sure they've caused you both a lot of trouble. Don't worry. Once I get them home, I'll make sure they learn their lesson!
say:16:1720429011:1.source_cn: 这两个小淘气，一定打扰您二位清净了吧，回去之后我一定好...

say:17:1720429012:1.text: By the way... while you were tracking them down, you only saw the one monkey, yes? There weren't any other... partners, were there?
say:17:1720429012:1.source_cn: 说起来……二位大人在抓捕的过程中，就只看到这一只猴子吗...

choice_prompt:18:1720429012.text: By the way... while you were tracking them down, you only saw the one monkey, yes? There weren't any other... partners, were there?
choice_prompt:18:1720429012.source_cn: 说起来……二位大人在抓捕的过程中，就只看到这一只猴子吗？没有别的……同伙？

say:19:1720429013:0.text: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!
say:19:1720429013:0.source_cn: 对对对！瞧我这脑子，又糊涂了！我就是随口一问，怕它们还...
say:19:1720429013:0.male: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!
say:19:1720429013:0.female: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!

say:20:1720429015:1.text: Natho, bring the gifts I prepared. We must thank our honored guests properly.
say:20:1720429015:1.source_cn: 纳班，快把我准备好的谢礼拿来，好好感谢两位大人！

say:24:1720429017:1.text: Please, accept this small token of my thanks.
say:24:1720429017:1.source_cn: 两位大人，这是我的一点心意。

say:25:1720429018:1.text: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
say:25:1720429018:1.source_cn: 不知两位大人等会还有没有安排？如果没有的话，请务必让在...
say:25:1720429018:1.male: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
say:25:1720429018:1.female: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...

choice_prompt:26:1720429018.text: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.source_cn: 不知两位大人等会还有没有安排？如果没有的话，请务必让在下做东款待，感谢两位大人的无私帮助……
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.male: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.female: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...

say:27:1720429019:1.text: Ah! Of course, of course. Royal matters come first. I spoke out of turn!
say:27:1720429019:1.source_cn: 原来如此！原来如此！那当然是正事要紧，正事要紧！是在下...

say:28:1720429020:1.text: Then I won't keep you another moment. Safe travels to you both!
say:28:1720429020:1.source_cn: 那么，我就不耽误两位大人的宝贵时间了。两位慢走，慢走！

choice:26:0:1.text: We already have somewhere to be.
choice:26:0:1.male: We already have somewhere to be.
choice:26:0:1.female: We already have somewhere to be.

choice:26:1:2.text: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 我受王室邀请，前去观礼
choice:26:1:2.male: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.
choice:26:1:2.female: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 那只鹦鹉不就是同伙吗？

say:30:1720429014:1.text: No, no, nothing of the sort. Forget I said anything! I was only asking in case they had some other hiding place and might end up causing more trouble in town!
say:30:1720429014:1.source_cn: 没有没有！绝对没有！您当我胡说八道！我就是随口一问，怕...
